errors.evidence: The figure does not mention anything about minimum wage increases or affected businesses; it shows the percentage share of different industries and business sizes among all businesses.
The description does not explicitly mention the small gap in the vertical axis between the industry categories and the business size categories.
The longest bar (Gastgewerbe) is approximately 48%, not 49%. This is within the ±3 percentage point tolerance but slightly overstates the value.
The bar for "Mittlere Betriebe (50-249)" is closer to 39%, not "knapp unter 40%" or 38-39%. The description slightly understates the value.
The bar for "Kleinbetriebe (10-49)" is closer to 32%, not "rund 30%".

errors.evidence: The description correctly identifies the categories but introduces an unsupported interpretation of the gap's purpose (implying it is for visual separation only). The gap is a structural feature but not explicitly explained in the figure.
